# D6 · Regulatory capture and consumer protection

**Scope.** Lobbying spend and registrations, rulemaking and its withdrawal, enforcement closures, revolving-door appointments, deceptive or unfair practices, refunds and penalties actually paid.

## Standing questions

- How much do watched entities report spending on federal lobbying, through which firms, on which issues?
- Which rules or enforcement matters were withdrawn, narrowed or closed, and what reason was given on the record?
- Where regulators announced consumer redress, is there a record that it was paid?

## Watched entities

OpenAI, Anthropic, PBC, xAI, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Alphabet / Google, Amazon / AWS, Meta Platforms, Palantir Technologies, Andreessen Horowitz
